twap_equals_spot.meaning: In UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice(), the computed timeWeightedAverage is mathematically equal to the current spot price tradePrice

amount_out_min_zero.meaning: BuyBackBurnerUniswap._performSwap() sets amountOutMin = 0 for the V2 DEX swap

buybacker_holds_secondtokens.meaning: The BuyBackBurner contract holds secondTokens waiting to be bought back into OLAS and burned

buyback_permissionless.meaning: buyBack is permissionless so any caller can invoke it

buyback_completes.meaning: the buyback call completes without reverting and the swap is executed

assumptions: The buyback flow calls UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice(maxSlippage) before performing the swap.
The Uniswap V2 pool is the venue used by BuyBackBurnerUniswap._performSwap().
Any caller may invoke buyBack to trigger the buyback-and-burn path.
The swap consumes secondTokens held by BuyBackBurner and returns OLAS to the contract.

unresolved.description: The report gives no numeric definition of maxSlippage, tradePrice, timeWeightedAverage, or the manipulated price bound, so the exact rejection threshold cannot be encoded as a numeric comparison.
The after-swap check arithmetic beyond the stated previousPrice +/- maxSlippage% relation is not provided, so it cannot be formalized as a separate numeric predicate.

limitations: imp_after_swap_check_passes is a secondary consequence of the same TWAP identity flaw and is deferred from the core V.
Attacker capital and pre-existing OLAS/secondToken holdings before Block N-1 are outside this core binding.
Fee-on-transfer, gas, and bridge2Burner constraints on the attacker's profit are not modeled.
The concrete manipulated spot price and fair market price are not available, so the V is represented at the completion/forbidden-effect level rather than as a quantified slippage loss.
